articles.title: Cozy escapism or festive trash? How Netflix holiday movies took over Christmas
articles.summary: The so-bad-it’s-good holiday film has become a new festive tradition. Stars Maddie Ziegler and Dennis Quaid explain why they’re so hard to resist “With the state of the world right now, people want an escape,” says Maddie Ziegler. The 24-year-old performer first shot to fame on the Lifetime reality show Dance Moms in 2011, before becoming the unlikely muse of the publicity-shy singer Sia , which led to a role in Steven Spielberg ’s West Side Story.
